title: A Small Sock Shop
paras: Mina has a small shop in [[london|London]]. She sells new [[sock|socks]] and fixes old ones. I bring my old pair to her on Monday. There is a [[pretty|pretty]] blue box in the window. Behind the [[glass|glass]], I can see small red socks in the box. People stop outside to look at them. Mina asks me to come back on Tuesday. I leave my socks on her table.

When I [[arrive|arrive]] on Tuesday, Mina is sitting by the left [[side|side]] of the table. She has a needle and some black thread in her hand. People can bring one [[sock|sock]] [[or|or]] a pair. Today she is fixing a large black pair. A [[policeman|policeman]] brought them to her [[once|once]] before. Now they have another small hole. His shoes are [[too|too]] tight with thick new [[sock|socks]], so he wants to keep these thin ones.

My socks are ready. Mina shows me her work. There are no holes now, and the new thread is almost the same colour as my socks. She puts them in a paper bag. I pay her and put the bag in my coat pocket. As I leave, another person comes in with a pair of green socks.
zh: 米娜在伦敦有一家小店。她卖新袜子，也修补旧袜子。星期一，我把自己的一双旧袜子带给她。橱窗里有一个漂亮的蓝色盒子。隔着玻璃，我能看到盒子里的红色小袜子。人们在外面停下来看。米娜让我星期二再来。我把袜子留在她的桌上。
星期二我到达时，米娜正坐在桌子的左侧。她手里拿着一根针和一些黑线。人们可以带来一只袜子，也可以带来一双。今天，她正在修补一双黑色的大袜子。一位男警察以前把它们送来过一次。现在它们又有了一个小洞。他穿上厚厚的新袜子时，鞋子就太紧，所以他想留着这双薄袜子。
我的袜子已经补好了。米娜把补好的地方给我看。现在没有洞了，新线的颜色也和我的袜子几乎一样。她把袜子放进一个纸袋。我付了钱，把袋子放进外套口袋。我离开时，又有一个人带着一双绿色袜子走进来。

q.s: Mina bought the blue box on Monday.
q.why: 原文提到蓝盒，但未说明何时购买。

q.s: The policeman's shoes are too loose with thick new socks.
q.why: 原文说穿厚新袜子时鞋子太紧，而非太松。

q.s: Mina puts my socks in a paper bag.
q.why: 原文明确说她把补好的袜子放进纸袋。
